en.headline: About 135 swimmers treated for light injuries after Victoria Harbour Swim
en.dek: Organisers said the injuries were mainly minor abrasions and cramps among roughly 3700 participants, after the final leisure group was cancelled due to strong currents.
body: About 135 participants suffered light injuries during Sunday morning’s Victoria Harbour Swim, the Hong Kong China Swimming Association said.
The association reported that the injuries were mainly minor abrasions and muscle cramps. Roughly 3700 people took part in the annual cross-harbour event from Wan Chai to Tsim Sha Tsui.

Earlier, organisers cancelled the final leisure group because of strong currents, affecting about 700 swimmers who were promised refunds. Association president Ronnie Wong said safety was the priority and that support boats had retrieved participants still in the water by mid-morning.

zh.headline: 維港泳約135名參加者受輕傷 主要為擦傷及抽筋
zh.dek: 主辦單位表示，約3700人參與的賽事中，傷者多屬輕微擦傷及抽筋，優悠組最後一組因水流急已取消。
body: 中國香港游泳總會表示，周日上午舉行的維港泳有約135名參加者受傷，傷勢屬輕微。
總會指，傷者主要是輕微擦傷及肌肉抽筋。全年活動約有3700人由灣仔游往尖沙咀參與。
稍早前，主辦方因維港水流過急，取消優悠組最後一組賽事，約700名泳手受影響並將獲退還報名費。會長王敏超強調安全為先，支援船隻已在上午將仍在水中的參加者接回。
